label: Capital Fleet
description: Capital-scale formations — whole fleets as a single subject, every item selling tonnage through concrete scale cues. Naval cadence is the deliberate aesthetic, so every item must also NAME itself as spaceflight hardware (starship, interstellar, orbital, drive) — the slug and label never reach the prompt, and a wet-navy line with no anchor gets rewritten into a boat.

items.name: dreadnought-wedge
items.text: a wedge of kilometer-class star dreadnoughts in staggered echelon, main drive bells glowing at every stern, gun batteries the size of city blocks along each flank, escort frigates holding tight to the hulls like pilot fish

items.name: carrier-group
items.text: a starfaring fleet carrier at the center of its escort screen, launch bays glowing along the ventral spine, starfighter wings streaming out of the catapult decks in ordered threads

items.name: colony-ark
items.text: an interstellar generation ark the size of a mountain range, habitat rings turning slowly amidships, its hull a geography of vents, domes and canyon-deep panel seams

items.name: refugee-convoy
items.text: a ragged refugee convoy of mismatched star freighters and old sublight liners, hull patches and improvised armor plating, holds strung with lit viewports like hillside villages

items.name: parade-escort
items.text: a ceremonial starship escort in parade formation, polished hulls mirror-bright, engine glow trimmed to a matched idle, signal lamps blinking in synchronized welcome patterns down the line

items.name: scarred-battle-group
items.text: a battle group limping home, scorched hulls open to vacuum in places, one cruiser under tow, running lights burning defiantly along every intact deck

items.name: harvester-fleet
items.text: a fusion-drive skimmer-harvester fleet trailing intake plumes, ram scoops glowing at the mouth, orbital tankers with bellies swollen and streaming condensate

items.name: leviathan-flagship
items.text: one leviathan flagship alone, a starship so long its bow and stern hang under different weather, antenna spires combing through the cloud tops as it moves

items.name: drop-armada
items.text: an invasion drop armada disgorging landing craft in synchronized waves, orbital drop pods streaking down ahead of it on parallel trails of re-entry fire

items.name: survey-flotilla
items.text: a quiet survey flotilla of starships at high anchor, sensor booms unfolded like insect antennae, hulls painted in high-visibility science orange against the sky
